intro: Exploring the Horde is an introductory quest that sends adventurers on an expansive tour of Horde leadership. Initiated by reporting to Nazgrel in Grommash Hold, the journey tasks travelers with seeking audiences with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. It establishes the diplomatic and military ties that unite the orcs, trolls, tauren, and Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.
If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you have returned. I hope that you learned much in your journey.

It is my understanding that your people are still establishing themselves in Mulgore. While you wait for them, I'd encourage you to explore the territory around Orgrimmar. The Barrens in particular is always in need of eager adventurers like yourself.
